recipes.title: Shakshuka
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and diced bell pepper until very soft, about 7 minutes.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and paprika. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on low heat for 6-8 minutes until the egg whites are set but yolks remain slightly runny.
Sprinkle crumbled feta and fresh cilantro over the top. Serve immediately from the skillet.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey and Soft Figs
instructions: Divide Greek yogurt between two bowls.
Top each bowl with quartered soft figs.
Drizzle honey generously over the yogurt and figs.
Dust with ground cinnamon and scatter sunflower seeds on top if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Egg Scramble with Spinach and Feta
instructions: Whisk the eggs with oregano, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add baby spinach and cook for 1-2 minutes until wilted.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and stir for 30 seconds.
Pour in the egg mixture and gently stir with a spatula, forming soft curds.
When the eggs are almost set but still slightly moist, remove from heat and fold in crumbled feta.
Serve immediately on warm plates.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced green peppers for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add diced tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Cook for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until tomatoes break down into a thick sauce.
Crack eggs directly into the sauce, gently stirring to create soft scrambled curds mixed throughout.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until eggs are just set but still creamy.
Garnish with fresh parsley and serve warm with soft bread.

recipes.title: Savory Mediterranean Oatmeal with Soft Egg
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil in a saucepan. Stir in rolled oats and reduce heat to medium-low.
Cook oats for 5 minutes, stirring often, until creamy and thick.
In a small skillet, heat olive oil and quickly wilt the baby spinach with cherry tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes until whites are set.
Divide savory oatmeal between bowls, top with wilted spinach and tomatoes, grated Parmesan, and a poached egg.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.

recipes.title: Ricotta and Herb Stuffed Soft Crepes
instructions: Whisk flour, eggs, milk, melted butter, and a pinch of salt until smooth. Let batter rest 5 minutes.
Heat a lightly greased non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about 3 tablespoons batter, swirl to coat, and cook 1-2 minutes per side.
Repeat to make 8 thin crepes.
In a bowl, combine ricotta, basil, dill, and lemon zest.
Spread 2 tablespoons of the ricotta mixture on each crepe and fold into quarters.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Frittata with Zucchini and Roasted Peppers
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Heat olive oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Sauté red onion and zucchini for 4-5 minutes until softened.
Add roasted red peppers and stir for 1 minute.
Whisk eggs with oregano, salt, and pepper. Pour over the vegetables in the skillet.
Cook on stovetop for 3 minutes without stirring until edges begin to set.
Scatter feta on top and transfer to the oven. Bake 12-15 minutes until puffed and golden.
Let rest 3 minutes before slicing into wedges.

recipes.title: Labneh Toast with Olive Oil and Za'atar
instructions: Lightly toast the soft bread slices until just warm but still pliable.
Spread a generous layer of labneh on each slice.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with za'atar.
Top with halved cherry tomatoes and cucumber slices if desired.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Soft Polenta with Poached Eggs and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Bring water to a boil with salt. Slowly whisk in polenta, reduce heat to low.
Cook polenta for 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently, until thick and creamy.
Stir in Parmesan and butter until melted and smooth.
Meanwhile, warm marinara sauce in a small saucepan.
Poach eggs in simmering water for 3-4 minutes.
Divide creamy polenta among bowls, spoon marinara sauce over the top, and place a poached egg on each.
Garnish with basil leaves.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Breakfast Strata
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease a 9x13 baking dish.
Spread cubed soft bread in the baking dish.
Layer spinach, sun-dried tomatoes, olives, and feta over the bread.
Whisk eggs, milk, oregano, salt, and pepper. Pour evenly over the bread mixture.
Press down gently so bread absorbs the custard. Let sit 10 minutes.
Bake 35-40 minutes until puffed, golden, and set in the center.
Let cool 5 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta and Roasted Tomato Egg Cups
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Blend feta and cream cheese in a food processor until smooth and whipped.
Divide whipped feta among 4 small ramekins, spreading along the bottom and sides.
Toss cherry tomatoes with olive oil, salt, and thyme. Nestle into the ramekins.
Crack an egg into each ramekin on top of the tomatoes and cheese.
Season with pepper and bake 15-18 minutes until egg whites are set.
Let cool 2 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Warm Semolina Porridge with Date Syrup and Tahini
instructions: Bring oat milk and a pinch of salt to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Slowly whisk in semolina, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Cook over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir in cinnamon.
Divide between bowls, drizzle with date syrup and tahini.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Soft Pita Wraps with Grilled Chicken and Tzatziki
instructions: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and salt for at least 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-sear chicken over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through (165°F internal).
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice thinly.
Make tzatziki: combine Greek yogurt, grated cucumber (squeezed dry), dill, and a pinch of salt.
Warm pita bread until soft and pliable.
Fill each pita with sliced chicken, lettuce, tomato, and generous tzatziki.
Roll up and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Spanakopita (Soft Flaky Version)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Sauté onion in 1 tablespoon olive oil until soft, about 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Let cool and squeeze out excess liquid.
In a large bowl, combine spinach mixture with feta, ricotta, eggs, scallions, dill, nutmeg, salt, and pepper.
Mix olive oil and melted butter together. Brush a 9x13 baking dish with the mixture.
Layer 6 sheets of phyllo in the dish, brushing each generously with the oil-butter mixture. Keep remaining phyllo covered with a damp towel.
Spread the spinach filling evenly over the phyllo layers.
Layer remaining 6 sheets on top, brushing each with the oil-butter mixture.
Score the top layers into squares or diamonds with a sharp knife.
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden and the phyllo layers are soft and flaky.
Let cool 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice and Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Brown ground turkey with garlic, oregano, and cumin for 5-6 minutes.
Stir in half the diced tomatoes, cooked rice, salt, and pepper.
Stuff each pepper with the turkey-rice mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Pour remaining diced tomatoes around the peppers in the dish.
Cover with foil and bake 35-40 minutes until peppers are very tender.
Uncover, top with feta and parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan White Bean and Tomato Stew
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add cannellini beans, diced tomatoes, sun-dried tomatoes, vegetable broth, basil, and red pepper flakes.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Use a potato masher to lightly crush about a third of the beans to thicken the stew.
Stir in spinach and cook 2-3 minutes until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve in bowls with a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Greek-Style Orzo Salad with Soft Vegetables
instructions: Cook orzo according to package directions until tender. Drain and rinse with cool water.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add cooked orzo, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, and red onion. Toss to combine.
Fold in crumbled feta gently.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

recipes.title: Warm Lentil and Roasted Vegetable Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Cook lentils in salted water for 20-25 minutes until tender. Drain.
Toss sweet potato, zucchini, and bell pepper with 2 tablespoons olive oil and cumin. Spread on a baking sheet.
Roast vegetables for 25 minutes until tender and lightly caramelized.
Make dressing: whisk tahini, lemon juice, garlic, remaining olive oil, and 2 tablespoons water.
Combine lentils and roasted vegetables in bowls. Drizzle with tahini dressing.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Eggplant and Chickpea Stew with Soft Flatbread
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Cook eggplant cubes for 5-6 minutes until softened and golden.
Add onion and garlic, cook 3 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in chickpeas, crushed tomatoes, cumin, cinnamon, and salt.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until eggplant is meltingly soft.
Stir in fresh parsley.
Serve warm with soft flatbread for dipping.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna Melt on Soft Roll

ingredients.displayName: Canned Tuna in Olive Oil, drained

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine drained tuna, olives, sun-dried tomatoes, red onion, capers, and lemon juice.
Split soft rolls and divide the tuna mixture between them.
Top each with sliced mozzarella.
Bake 6-8 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly.
Add fresh basil leaves and serve warm.

recipes.title: Creamy Greek Chicken and Rice Casserole
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Brown chicken thighs on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Sauté onion until soft, 4 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir for 1 minute. Pour in broth, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Return chicken to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer 18-20 minutes until rice is tender.
Fold in spinach until wilted, top with feta, and serve.

recipes.title: Soft Falafel Bowl with Tahini Sauce
instructions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, cumin, coriander, flour, and 0.5 tsp salt in a food processor until a coarse paste forms. Do not over-process.
Shape into small patties and refrigerate 15 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry falafel 3-4 minutes per side until golden on the outside and soft inside.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini, lemon juice, remaining salt, and 3 tablespoons water until smooth.
Assemble bowls with rice, falafel patties, diced cucumber and tomato.
Drizzle generously with tahini sauce.

recipes.title: Roasted Red Pepper and Goat Cheese Pasta
instructions: Cook penne according to package directions until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Blend roasted red peppers, goat cheese, garlic, olive oil, and cream until smooth.
Pour the sauce into a large skillet over medium-low heat. Warm gently for 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and toss, adding reserved pasta water as needed for silky consistency.
Season with salt and pepper. Garnish with fresh basil and serve.

recipes.title: Warm Couscous with Roasted Vegetables and Lemon Yogurt
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C).
Toss zucchini, eggplant, and cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, cumin, and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast 20 minutes until vegetables are very tender.
Pour hot broth over couscous in a bowl, cover, and let sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Mix Greek yogurt with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Serve couscous topped with roasted vegetables, dollops of lemon yogurt, and fresh mint.

recipes.title: Italian Wedding Soup (Soft Meatballs)

ingredients.displayName: Acini di Pepe or Small Pasta

instructions: Combine ground chicken, breadcrumbs, Parmesan, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper. Roll into 1-inch meatballs.
Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add meatballs and cook 5 minutes.
Add small pasta and cook another 8-10 minutes until pasta is tender and meatballs are cooked through.
Stir in escarole or spinach and cook 2 minutes until wilted.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with extra Parmesan.

recipes.title: Braised Lamb with Orzo
instructions: Season lamb generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear lamb in batches until deeply browned on all sides, about 8 minutes total. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in red wine and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pot. Cook until wine reduces by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, and oregano. Return lamb to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a low simmer. Cover and cook for 1.5 hours until lamb is fork-tender.
Remove cinnamon stick and bay leaves. Stir in orzo.
Cover and cook an additional 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until orzo is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid.
The dish should be thick and stew-like. Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Risotto Milanese
instructions: Steep saffron threads in 0.5 cup of warm broth for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a wide heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat.
Sauté onion for 4-5 minutes until translucent.
Add arborio rice and stir for 2 minutes until edges turn translucent.
Pour in white wine and stir until absorbed.
Add the saffron broth. Begin adding remaining warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently, waiting until each addition is mostly absorbed before adding the next.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and tender with a slight bite.
Remove from heat. Stir in remaining butter and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper.
Let rest 2 minutes, then serve immediately. The risotto should flow slowly when spooned onto a plate.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Soak dried porcini in 1 cup hot water for 10 minutes. Strain and reserve soaking liquid. Chop porcini.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large pan. Sauté sliced fresh mushrooms over high heat until golden and tender, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add remaining olive oil. Sauté onion for 4 minutes until soft. Add garlic and chopped porcini, cook 1 minute.
Add arborio rice and stir 2 minutes. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add porcini soaking liquid. Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
Continue for 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy.
Return sautéed mushrooms to the risotto. Stir in remaining butter, Parmesan, and thyme.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Seafood Risotto
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a pan. Quickly sear shrimp and calamari for 2 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, sauté shallots in remaining olive oil for 3 minutes. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir 2 minutes. Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Add cherry tomatoes. Begin adding warm stock one ladle at a time, stirring frequently.
After 12 minutes, add mussels. Continue adding stock and cooking for another 6-8 minutes until rice is creamy and mussels have opened (discard any that remain closed).
Return shrimp and calamari to the risotto. Stir in butter, lemon juice, and parsley.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon and Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Place salmon fillets on the baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Spread minced garlic over each fillet. Season with salt and pepper.
Top with fresh dill, parsley, and capers. Lay lemon slices over the fish.
Bake 15-18 minutes until salmon flakes easily with a fork and reaches 145°F internal temperature.
Let rest 2 minutes. Serve with additional lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata with Soft Linguine
instructions: Cook linguine according to package directions until tender. Drain and keep warm.
Season chicken cutlets with salt and pepper, then dredge lightly in flour.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken 3-4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove to a plate.
In the same skillet, add broth and lemon juice. Scrape up browned bits and simmer 3 minutes.
Add capers and remaining butter. Swirl until butter melts and sauce thickens slightly.
Return chicken to the pan. Spoon sauce over the chicken.
Serve chicken and sauce over linguine, garnished with parsley.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Chicken Thighs with Olives and Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
Season chicken thighs with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes until golden. Flip and sear 2 more minutes. Remove.
Sauté onion and garlic in the drippings for 3 minutes.
Pour in wine and scrape up browned bits. Cook 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes, olives, and thyme. Nestle chicken back in, skin-side up.
Cover and braise in the oven for 40-45 minutes until chicken is very tender and falling off the bone.
Serve chicken with the braising sauce spooned over the top.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
instructions: Cook angel hair pasta until just tender. Reserve 1 cup pasta water and drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Sauté shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink. Remove.
Add butter and garlic to the skillet. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in wine and cook 2 minutes until reduced by half.
Stir in cream, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in pasta, Parmesan, and red pepper flakes. Add pasta water as needed for silky sauce.
Return shrimp to the pan, toss gently, and garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan (Melanzane alla Parmigiana)
instructions: Salt eggplant slices and let sit 20 minutes to draw out moisture. Pat dry.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Set up a breading station: flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs. Coat each eggplant slice.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Pan-fry eggplant slices 2-3 minutes per side until tender and golden. Drain on paper towels.
Spread 1 cup marinara in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer half the eggplant, half the remaining sauce, half the mozzarella, and some Parmesan.
Repeat layers. Top with remaining Parmesan.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Let rest 10 minutes. Garnish with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Brush eggplant slices with olive oil and roast on a baking sheet for 20 minutes until tender.
Brown ground lamb in a skillet. Add onion and garlic, cook 5 minutes.
Stir in tomatoes, wine, cinnamon, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.

Make béchamel: Melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour and cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in milk. Cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and whisk in egg yolks, nutmeg, and half the Parmesan.
Layer roasted eggplant in a 9x13 dish, then meat sauce, then remaining eggplant.
Pour béchamel over the top. Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan.
Bake 40-45 minutes until golden and bubbly.
Let rest 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Cod en Papillote
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Cut 4 large pieces of parchment paper.
Place a bed of zucchini slices in the center of each parchment sheet.
Place a cod fillet on each bed of zucchini. Season with salt and pepper.
Divide cherry tomatoes and olives among the packets. Add lemon slices and herbs.
Drizzle each with olive oil. Fold parchment to create sealed packets.
Place on a baking sheet and bake 15-18 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Carefully open packets at the table to release the aromatic steam.

recipes.title: Baked Mediterranean Chicken with Artichokes and Tomatoes

ingredients.displayName: Canned Artichoke Hearts, drained and quartered

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken with salt, pepper, oregano, and paprika.
Toss artichoke hearts, cherry tomatoes, olives, and garlic with 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large baking dish.
Nestle chicken among the vegetables. Drizzle with remaining olive oil and lemon juice.
Bake 30-35 minutes until chicken reaches 165°F and vegetables are tender.
Garnish with fresh basil and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan Gnocchi
instructions: Cook gnocchi according to package directions until they float. Drain.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet. Sauté garlic and sun-dried tomatoes for 1 minute.
Add cream, basil, and red pepper flakes. Simmer 3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Stir in spinach until wilted.
Add cooked gnocchi and Parmesan. Toss gently until coated.
Season with salt and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Herb-Crusted Tilapia with Warm Tomato Compote
instructions: Season tilapia with salt, pepper, and 1 tablespoon lemon juice.
Mix parsley, dill, and garlic. Press herb mixture onto the top of each fillet.
Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat. Cook fish herb-side down for 3 minutes, flip gently, and cook 3 more minutes.
Remove fish. In the same skillet, add remaining olive oil and sauté tomatoes and capers for 3-4 minutes until tomatoes soften into a warm compote.
Add remaining lemon juice to the compote.
Serve tilapia over the warm tomato compote.

recipes.title: One-Pot Mediterranean Beef and Vegetable Stew
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper. Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over high heat. Sear beef in batches until browned. Remove.
Reduce heat to medium. Sauté onion for 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Pour in red wine and scrape up browned bits. Cook 2 minutes.
Return beef and add crushed tomatoes, broth, oregano, and bay leaves.
Bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 45 minutes.
Add potatoes, cover and cook 20 minutes more.
Add zucchini and cook uncovered 15 minutes until all vegetables are very tender.
Remove bay leaves, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Creamy Spinach and Artichoke Stuffed Shells
instructions: Cook pasta shells until just al dente. Drain and cool.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Combine ricotta, wilted spinach, artichoke hearts, half the mozzarella, Parmesan, egg, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Spread 1 cup marinara in a 9x13 baking dish.
Fill each shell with a generous tablespoon of the ricotta mixture. Arrange in the dish.
Pour remaining sauce over the shells. Top with remaining mozzarella.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes. Uncover and bake 5 more minutes until cheese is bubbly.
Garnish with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked White Fish with Fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss sliced fennel and cherry tomatoes with 2 tablespoons olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper in a baking dish.
Roast vegetables for 10 minutes until fennel begins to soften.
Nestle fish fillets among the vegetables. Drizzle with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and wine.
Return to oven and bake 12-15 minutes until fish flakes easily.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the roasted vegetables and pan juices.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta with Yogurt Sauce over Rice
instructions: Combine lamb, grated onion, garlic, cumin, coriander, cinnamon, parsley, mint, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Shape into oval kofta about 3 inches long.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook kofta 3-4 minutes per side until cooked through and tender.
Make yogurt sauce: mix Greek yogurt, lemon juice, remaining mint, and a pinch of salt.
Serve kofta over warm rice with generous spoonfuls of yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Add chicken breast, reduce heat, and simmer 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred into small pieces.
Return broth to a simmer. Add rice and cook 15 minutes until very tender.
In a bowl, whisk eggs and lemon juice vigorously until frothy.
Slowly ladle 2 cups of hot broth into the egg-lemon mixture, whisking constantly to temper the eggs (this prevents curdling).
Pour the tempered mixture back into the pot, stirring continuously. Cook on low heat for 2-3 minutes until the soup thickens slightly. Do not boil.
Return shredded chicken to the soup. Add lemon zest, salt, and white pepper.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with fresh dill.

recipes.title: Greek Egg Lemon Soup (Vegetarian Avgolemono)
instructions: Bring vegetable broth to a boil. Add orzo and cook until very tender, about 10 minutes.
Reduce heat to very low.
Whisk eggs and lemon juice together in a bowl until frothy.
Slowly ladle 1.5 cups of hot broth into the egg-lemon mixture, whisking constantly.
Pour the tempered mixture back into the pot, stirring gently. Do not let it boil.
Stir in butter, lemon zest, salt, and white pepper.
Serve in warm bowls garnished with fresh dill. The soup should be velvety and creamy.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lentil Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, cumin, and turmeric. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add red lentils, vegetable broth, and diced tomatoes. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 25-30 minutes until lentils are completely broken down and soft.
For a creamier texture, use an immersion blender to partially purée the soup.
Stir in spinach (if using) and cook until wilted.
Add lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

recipes.title: Pasta e Fagioli
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook pancetta until lightly rendered, about 3 minutes.
Add onion, celery, and garlic. Sauté 5 minutes until softened.
Add crushed tomatoes, chicken broth, 1 can of beans (whole), oregano, and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
Mash the second can of beans with a fork and add them to thicken the soup.
Add ditalini pasta and cook 10-12 minutes until pasta is tender.
Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf.
Serve topped with Parmesan and parsley.

recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Red Pepper Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat. Sauté onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and smoked paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Add roasted red peppers and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to purée until completely smooth.
Stir in heavy cream, salt, and pepper.
Serve garnished with basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Moroccan-Spiced Chickpea and Sweet Potato Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger for 1 minute.
Add cumin, cinnamon, and turmeric. Stir 30 seconds.
Add sweet potatoes, chickpeas, diced tomatoes, and broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 25 minutes until sweet potatoes are very tender.
Partially blend with an immersion blender for a thick, creamy texture (leave some chunks).
Stir in lemon juice and salt. Serve topped with cilantro.

recipes.title: Tuscan Tomato and Bread Soup (Pappa al Pomodoro)

ingredients.displayName: Day-Old Soft Bread, torn into pieces

instructions: Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a pot. Gently cook garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add crushed tomatoes, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.
Add torn bread and broth. Stir well. Simmer 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the bread breaks down completely and the soup becomes thick and porridge-like.
Tear in most of the basil and stir.
Serve drizzled with remaining olive oil and topped with basil leaves.

recipes.title: Silky Zucchini and Leek Soup with Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Leek, white and light green parts, sliced

instructions: Heat olive oil in a pot. Sauté leeks for 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic and zucchini. Cook 3 minutes.
Pour in broth, bring to a boil, then simmer 12-15 minutes until zucchini is very tender.
Add basil and mint. Blend with an immersion blender until completely silky smooth.
Stir in lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Serve with a swirl of Greek yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Hummus
instructions: Process tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute until thick and whipped.
Add garlic, cumin, and salt. Process 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and process 1 minute. Scrape sides.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil and ice water. Process 2-3 minutes until extremely smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust lemon juice and salt.
Serve in a shallow bowl, swirled with a spoon, drizzled with olive oil, and sprinkled with paprika.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C). Pierce eggplants several times with a fork.
Place eggplants directly on oven rack (with a tray below to catch drips). Roast 35-40 minutes until completely collapsed and very soft.
Let cool slightly. Cut in half and scoop the smoky flesh into a colander. Let drain 5 minutes.
Transfer eggplant flesh to a food processor with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and salt.
Pulse until smooth but still with some texture.
Spread on a plate, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with smoked paprika and parsley.
Serve with warm soft pita bread.

recipes.title: Whipped Feta Dip with Roasted Garlic
instructions: Slice the top off the garlic head, drizzle with a little olive oil, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F for 25-30 minutes until soft and golden.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves from their skins.
Combine feta, cream cheese, roasted garlic, olive oil, and lemon juice in a food processor.
Process 2-3 minutes until completely smooth and whipped.
Transfer to a bowl, garnish with dill and a drizzle of olive oil.
Serve with warm soft pita or soft vegetables.

recipes.title: Tzatziki Dip

ingredients.displayName: English Cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

instructions: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out as much liquid as possible using a clean towel or cheesecloth.
Combine Greek yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill, and salt in a bowl.
Stir well and taste for seasoning.
Refrigerate at least 30 minutes to let flavors meld.
Serve drizzled with olive oil alongside soft pita or cooked vegetables.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Marinated Roasted Peppers
instructions: Roast whole peppers under a broiler, turning occasionally, until charred on all sides, about 15-20 minutes.
Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and steam 10 minutes.
Peel, seed, and slice peppers into strips.
Toss with olive oil, garlic, vinegar, basil, oregano, and salt.
Let marinate at least 30 minutes at room temperature.
Serve as an appetizer or alongside soft bread and cheese.

recipes.title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes with Olive Oil and Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Yukon Gold Potatoes, peeled and cubed

instructions: Boil potatoes in salted water for 15-18 minutes until very tender. Drain well.
Warm olive oil and garlic gently in a small pan for 2 minutes (do not brown).
Mash potatoes with the garlic olive oil and warm milk until smooth and creamy.
Stir in rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Serve topped with chives and an extra drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Sautéed Lemony Green Beans with Garlic
instructions: Blanch green beans in boiling salted water for 3 minutes. Drain and pat dry.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add green beans and sauté 4-5 minutes until tender and lightly blistered.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 1 minute.
Remove from heat. Toss with lemon juice, lemon zest, and salt.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Braised Greens with Garlic and Olive Oil

ingredients.displayName: Swiss Chard or Kale, stems removed, chopped

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add garlic and red pepper flakes. Cook 1 minute until garlic is fragrant.
Add chopped greens in batches, tossing with tongs as they wilt.
Add 2 tablespoons water, cover, and cook 8-10 minutes until greens are very tender.
Season with salt and lemon juice.
Drizzle with additional olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Soft Mediterranean Cucumber and Tomato Salad
instructions: Combine cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, and olives in a large bowl.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Pour dressing over vegetables and toss gently.
Let sit 10 minutes at room temperature to allow flavors to meld.
Serve as a refreshing side dish.

recipes.title: Slow-Roasted Cherry Tomatoes with Herbs
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (165°C).
Spread cherry tomatoes on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Toss with olive oil, garlic, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Roast 40-45 minutes until tomatoes are very soft, collapsed, and intensely sweet.
Drizzle with balsamic vinegar.
Serve warm as a side dish, over pasta, or spooned onto soft bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Polenta with Parmesan
instructions: Bring water and milk to a boil with salt.
Slowly whisk in polenta in a thin stream, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to very low. Cook 20-25 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the polenta is thick, creamy, and pulls away from the sides of the pot.
Remove from heat. Stir in butter, Parmesan, olive oil, and pepper.
Serve immediately while hot and flowing. The polenta should be the consistency of thick porridge.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Feta and Fresh Herbs
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté diced onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika; cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in crushed tomatoes, season with salt and pepper, and simmer for 10 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Make 6 small wells in the sauce and crack an egg into each well.
Cover the skillet and cook on medium-low for 6-8 minutes until egg whites are set but yolks are still runny.
Crumble feta cheese over the top and sprinkle with fresh parsley.
Serve immediately from the skillet with soft pita or crusty-free bread.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt with Honey, Soft Figs and Seeds
instructions: Divide Greek yogurt between two bowls.
Drizzle honey generously over each portion.
Top with quartered soft dried figs and sunflower seeds.
Dust with a pinch of ground cinnamon and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Tortilla Española (Spanish Potato Omelette)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a 10-inch non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Gently fry potato slices and onion in the oil, turning occasionally, until potatoes are very tender but not browned, about 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, beat eggs in a large bowl with salt and pepper.
Drain potatoes and onion, reserving oil. Fold the potato mixture into the beaten eggs and let sit 5 minutes.
Heat 2 tablespoons of reserved oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Pour in the egg-potato mixture, reduce heat to medium-low, and cook until the bottom is set and golden, about 5 minutes.
Place a large plate over the skillet and carefully flip the tortilla onto the plate, then slide it back into the skillet.
Cook for another 3-4 minutes until just set in the center.
Slide onto a cutting board, let rest 5 minutes, then slice into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen (Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes and Peppers)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat.
Add diced green peppers and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add diced tomatoes, red pepper flakes, and salt. Cook until tomatoes break down into a sauce, about 7 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and pour in beaten eggs, stirring gently to create soft curds mixed throughout the tomato sauce.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until eggs are just set but still creamy, about 3 minutes.
Remove from heat, garnish with fresh parsley, and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Moroccan Semolina Breakfast Porridge (Herbel)
instructions: Bring water with salt to a boil in a medium saucepan.
Gradually whisk in the semolina, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
Reduce heat to low and cook, stirring frequently, for 5-7 minutes until thick and creamy.
Stir in butter, honey, cinnamon, and orange blossom water if using.
Serve warm in bowls, drizzled with additional honey if desired.

recipes.title: Labneh Toast with Za'atar and Soft Roasted Tomatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Toss cherry tomato halves with 1 tablespoon olive oil and salt on a baking sheet.
Roast for 12-15 minutes until tomatoes are soft and slightly blistered.
Lightly toast the bread slices just until warmed (keep them soft, not crunchy).
Spread a generous layer of labneh on each slice.
Top with roasted tomatoes, sprinkle with za'atar, and drizzle with remaining olive oil.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Italian Egg and Ricotta Bake with Spinach
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Grease a baking dish with olive oil.
Sauté garlic in a skillet for 30 seconds, add spinach and wilt completely. Drain any excess liquid.
Whisk eggs with ricotta, half the parmesan, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Fold in wilted spinach and chopped sun-dried tomatoes.
Pour mixture into the prepared baking dish and top with remaining parmesan.
Bake for 22-25 minutes until puffed and set in the center.
Let cool 5 minutes, top with fresh basil leaves, and serve in squares.

recipes.title: Ful Medames (Egyptian Mashed Fava Beans)
instructions: Place drained fava beans in a saucepan with 0.5 cup water. Heat over medium until simmering.
Mash about half the beans with a fork, leaving some whole for texture.
Stir in garlic, cumin, lemon juice, and salt. Cook 5 more minutes.
Transfer to a serving bowl and drizzle generously with olive oil and tahini if using.
Top with diced tomato and fresh parsley. Serve warm with soft flatbread.

recipes.title: Savory French Mediterranean Crêpes with Ratatouille Filling
instructions: Blend flour, eggs, milk, water, melted butter, and salt until smooth. Refrigerate batter 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet. Sauté eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper until very soft, about 10 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and herbes de Provence. Simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Heat a lightly buttered non-stick pan over medium heat. Pour about 3 tablespoons of batter, swirling to coat the pan.
Cook crêpe until edges lift easily, about 1 minute per side.
Repeat with remaining batter to make 8 crêpes.
Fill each crêpe with the warm ratatouille filling, fold, top with shredded Gruyère, and serve.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi (Chickpea Breakfast Stew)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté garlic for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas with 2 cups of water, cumin, harissa paste, and salt.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes, mashing some chickpeas to thicken the broth.
Meanwhile, soft-boil eggs for 6 minutes, then peel and halve.
Place torn bread in serving bowls. Ladle the hot chickpea stew over the bread so it softens completely.
Top each bowl with a halved soft-boiled egg, a drizzle of olive oil, lemon juice, and fresh cilantro.

recipes.title: Pastitsio (Greek Baked Pasta with Meat Sauce)
instructions: Cook penne pasta until al dente, drain, and toss with a little olive oil.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil and brown ground lamb over medium-high heat, breaking it up.
Add onion and garlic, cook until softened. Stir in tomato paste, crushed tomatoes, cinnamon, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes.
Make béchamel: melt butter in a saucepan, whisk in flour, cook 1 minute. Gradually whisk in milk and cook until thick, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat, stir in nutmeg and egg yolks.
Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
Layer half the pasta in a greased 9x13 baking dish, top with all the meat sauce, then remaining pasta.
Pour béchamel evenly over top and sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake 35-40 minutes until golden and bubbling. Let rest 15 minutes before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Imam Bayildi (Turkish Stuffed Eggplant)
instructions: Halve eggplants lengthwise and score the flesh in a crosshatch pattern. Salt generously and let sit 20 minutes, then pat dry.
Heat half the olive oil in a large skillet and sear eggplant halves cut-side down until golden. Transfer to a baking dish.
In the same skillet, add remaining oil. Sauté onions until very soft and golden, about 12 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add tomatoes, parsley, sugar, lemon juice, and salt. Cook 5 minutes.
Spoon the onion-tomato mixture generously over each eggplant half.
Add 0.5 cup water to the baking dish, cover with foil, and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40-45 minutes until eggplant is completely tender.
Serve warm or at room temperature, drizzled with additional olive oil.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Tagine with Preserved Lemons and Olives
instructions: Season chicken thighs with salt, turmeric, cumin, and saffron.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown chicken on both sides, about 8 minutes total. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat, add grated onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, add chicken broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low for 40 minutes until chicken is fall-off-the-bone tender.
Add preserved lemon slices and green olives, cook uncovered 10 more minutes.
Garnish generously with fresh cilantro and serve over fluffy couscous.

recipes.title: Dolmas (Stuffed Grape Leaves with Rice and Herbs)
instructions: Soak rice in hot water for 10 minutes, then drain well.
Mix rice with diced onion, 2 tablespoons olive oil, all fresh herbs, tomato paste, half the lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Lay a grape leaf flat, vein-side up. Place 1 tablespoon of filling near the stem end.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly from stem to tip. Repeat with remaining leaves and filling.
Line the bottom of a pot with any torn or extra grape leaves.
Arrange dolmas seam-side down in tight concentric circles. Layer if needed.
Mix water with remaining olive oil and lemon juice, pour over dolmas.
Place a heavy plate on top to keep dolmas submerged. Cover and simmer gently for 45 minutes.
Let cool in the pot before serving at room temperature with yogurt on the side.

recipes.title: Turkish Lamb Kofte with Yogurt Sauce
instructions: Combine ground lamb, grated onion (squeeze out excess liquid), garlic, cumin, paprika, parsley, salt, and pepper in a bowl. Mix well.
Form mixture into oval-shaped kofte, about 2 inches long. You should get about 16 pieces.
Mix yogurt with lemon juice, mint, and a pinch of salt for the sauce.
Heat olive oil in a grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook kofte for 3-4 minutes per side until well-browned outside and cooked through.
Serve kofte over warm soft flatbread or rice with the yogurt-mint sauce drizzled over top.

recipes.title: Soft Fattoush Salad with Sumac Dressing

ingredients.displayName: Soft Pita Bread, torn into pieces

instructions: Warm pita bread briefly in the oven just until soft and pliable (not toasted crispy), then tear into bite-sized pieces.
Combine lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes, radishes, green onions, mint, and parsley in a large bowl.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, sumac, pomegranate molasses if using, and salt.
Add soft pita pieces to the salad, pour dressing over, and toss gently to combine.
Serve immediately while the pita is still soft, sprinkled with extra sumac.

recipes.title: Seafood Paella Valenciana
instructions: Bloom saffron in 2 tablespoons of warm stock for 5 minutes.
Heat olive oil in a wide paella pan or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sauté onion and bell pepper until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add grated tomato and smoked paprika, cook 3 minutes.
Add rice, stirring to coat in the sauce. Pour in warm fish stock and saffron liquid. Season with salt.
Arrange rice evenly, bring to a boil, then reduce to medium. Do not stir from this point.
After 12 minutes, nestle shrimp and calamari into the rice. Arrange mussels hinge-side down on top.
Scatter peas over everything. Cook 8-10 more minutes until rice is tender, mussels have opened, and shrimp are pink.
Remove from heat, cover with a towel, and rest 5 minutes.
Garnish with parsley and serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Creamy Lemon Orzo with Artichokes and Peas

ingredients.displayName: Canned Artichoke Hearts, drained and quartered

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Sauté garlic for 30 seconds.
Add orzo and stir to coat in oil. Pour in vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, for 8-10 minutes until orzo is almost tender.
Add artichoke hearts and peas, cook 3 more minutes.
Stir in cream cheese, parmesan, lemon zest, and lemon juice until creamy.
Season with salt and pepper, garnish with fresh dill, and serve warm.

recipes.title: Lebanese Kibbeh Bil Sanieh (Baked Kibbeh)
instructions: Soak fine bulgur in cold water for 15 minutes, then drain and squeeze dry.
In a food processor, blend soaked bulgur, half the lamb, quartered onion, allspice, cinnamon, cumin, salt, and pepper into a smooth paste.
For the filling: heat 1 tablespoon oil, sauté diced onion until soft, add ground beef and remaining lamb, cook until browned. Add sunflower seeds and season well.
Press half the bulgur-lamb mixture evenly into a greased 9x13 baking dish.
Spread the cooked meat filling evenly over the base layer.
Top with remaining bulgur-lamb mixture, pressing gently and smoothing the surface.
Score the top into diamond shapes with a sharp knife. Drizzle generously with olive oil.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 30-35 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
Let rest 10 minutes before serving with yogurt and a simple salad.

recipes.title: Greek Moussaka
instructions: Salt eggplant slices, let sit 20 minutes, pat dry. Brush with olive oil and bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until soft.
Parboil potato slices for 5 minutes until just tender, drain.
Brown ground lamb in a large skillet, drain excess fat. Add onion and garlic, cook until soft.
Add wine, crushed tomatoes, cinnamon, oregano, salt, and pepper. Simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Make béchamel: melt butter, whisk in flour, cook 1 minute. Gradually add milk, whisk until thick. Remove from heat, stir in egg yolks and nutmeg.
Layer in a 9x13 dish: potatoes, then eggplant, then meat sauce.
Pour béchamel over top, sprinkle with parmesan.
Bake at 350°F (175°C) for 45 minutes until golden and bubbling.
Rest 20 minutes before cutting into squares to serve.

recipes.title: Tabbouleh (Fine-Chopped Parsley and Bulgur Salad)

ingredients.displayName: Fresh Flat-Leaf Parsley, very finely chopped

instructions: Soak fine bulgur in warm water for 15 minutes until tender. Drain thoroughly, pressing out all water.
In a large bowl, combine the very finely chopped parsley, mint, diced tomatoes, and green onions.
Add the drained bulgur and toss to combine.
Whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and allspice if using.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
Let sit for 10 minutes for flavors to meld. Serve at room temperature, scooping with soft lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Italian Caprese Pasta Salad with Fresh Mozzarella
instructions: Cook fusilli in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and rinse with cool water.
Whisk together olive oil, balsamic vinegar, garlic, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine pasta, mozzarella cubes, halved cherry tomatoes, and torn basil.
Pour dressing over and toss gently to combine.
Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled. Flavors improve after 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Soft-Cooked Broccoli
instructions: Cook spaghetti in heavily salted boiling water until al dente. Add broccoli florets in the last 3 minutes so they become very soft. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat. Add sliced garlic and red pepper flakes, cooking gently until garlic is golden (not browned), about 3 minutes.
Add drained spaghetti and soft broccoli to the skillet. Toss vigorously with 0.5 cup reserved pasta water.
Add lemon juice and parsley, toss again, adding more pasta water if needed for a silky sauce.
Serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Lamb and Apricot Tagine with Couscous
instructions: Season lamb cubes with salt, cumin, coriander, and turmeric.
Heat olive oil in a tagine or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown lamb in batches, set aside.
Sauté onion until golden, add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute.
Return lamb, add cinnamon stick, broth, and honey. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook on low heat for 1 hour until lamb is nearly tender.
Add dried apricots and cook 30 more minutes until lamb is fall-apart tender and apricots are plump.
Meanwhile, prepare couscous by pouring 1.5 cups boiling salted water over couscous, cover and let sit 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Serve tagine over fluffy couscous, garnished with cilantro.

recipes.title: French Bouillabaisse (Provençal Seafood Stew)

ingredients.displayName: Firm White Fish (cod or halibut), cubed

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat.
Sauté onion, leek, and fennel until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Pour in white wine and let it reduce by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, fish stock, saffron, orange peel, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer and cook 15 minutes for flavors to develop.
Add the cubed firm fish and cook 3 minutes.
Add shrimp and mussels, cover and cook 5-7 minutes until mussels open and shrimp are pink.
Discard any unopened mussels and the orange peel.
Ladle into warm bowls, garnish with parsley, and serve with a side of soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Classic French Ratatouille

ingredients.displayName: Yellow Squash, sliced into thin rounds
Roma Tomatoes, sliced into thin rounds

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a skillet, sauté diced onion and bell pepper in 1 tablespoon olive oil until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in crushed tomatoes, half the herbes de Provence, salt, and pepper. Spread this sauce evenly in a baking dish.
Arrange alternating slices of eggplant, zucchini, yellow squash, and tomato in tight concentric circles over the sauce.
Drizzle with remaining olive oil and sprinkle with remaining herbes de Provence.
Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes until vegetables are very soft.
Top with fresh basil and serve warm.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Lemon-Dill Yogurt and Soft Vegetables
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Arrange zucchini slices and cherry tomatoes on a sheet pan. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Place salmon fillets on top of the vegetables, drizzle with remaining oil, and lay lemon slices on top.
Bake 20-25 minutes until salmon flakes easily and vegetables are tender.
Meanwhile, mix yogurt with lemon juice, minced garlic, 2 tablespoons chopped dill, and a pinch of salt.
Serve salmon and vegetables with a generous dollop of lemon-dill yogurt, garnished with remaining dill.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowl
instructions: Marinate chicken thighs in olive oil, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, paprika, turmeric, cinnamon, garlic, and salt for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a grill pan or heavy skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook chicken thighs 5-6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through (internal temp 165°F).
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Make tahini sauce: whisk tahini with 3 tablespoons water, a squeeze of lemon, and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Assemble bowls with rice, sliced chicken, diced cucumber, diced tomato, and pickled turnips if using.
Drizzle with tahini sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Risotto ai Funghi (Italian Mushroom Risotto)
instructions: Soak dried porcini in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes. Strain, reserving the liquid. Chop porcini.
Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large heavy saucepan over medium-high heat.
Sauté fresh mushrooms with thyme until golden and tender, about 6 minutes. Add porcini, cook 1 minute. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add 1 tablespoon butter, sauté shallot until translucent. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds.
Add rice and stir for 2 minutes until edges are translucent.
Pour in wine and stir until absorbed.
Begin adding warm broth and porcini liquid, one ladle at a time, stirring frequently and waiting until each addition is absorbed before adding the next.
Continue for about 18-20 minutes until rice is creamy and al dente.
Remove from heat, stir in remaining butter, parmesan, and reserved mushrooms.
Season with salt and pepper, serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Turkish Pide with Spiced Ground Beef
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water. Let sit 5 minutes until foamy.
Mix flour and 1 teaspoon salt, add yeast mixture and 2 tablespoons olive oil. Knead into a soft dough, about 5 minutes. Cover and rest 30 minutes.
Mix raw ground beef with onion, pepper, tomato, tomato paste, cumin, red pepper flakes, and remaining salt.
Divide dough into 4 pieces. Roll each into an oval shape, about 10 inches long.
Place on parchment-lined baking sheets. Spread meat mixture over each, leaving a border.
Fold and pinch the edges up to create a boat shape.
Bake at 475°F (245°C) for 12-15 minutes until dough is cooked and meat is done.
Optionally crack an egg into the center of each pide in the last 3 minutes of baking.
Brush edges with melted butter and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Penne alla Vodka with Soft Roasted Tomatoes
instructions: Cook penne in salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Sauté shallot until softened, add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 1 minute.
Carefully add vodka and cook until reduced by half, about 2 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, salt, and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in heavy cream and simmer 5 more minutes until sauce is silky and pink.
Add drained penne and half the parmesan. Toss, adding pasta water as needed for the right consistency.
Serve topped with remaining parmesan and torn fresh basil.

recipes.title: Greek Braised Chicken with Lemon and Soft Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and oregano.
Arrange chicken and quartered potatoes in a large roasting pan.
Whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, and broth. Scatter garlic around the pan.
Pour the liquid over chicken and potatoes.
Roast for 55-60 minutes, basting halfway through, until chicken is golden and potatoes are very soft.
Garnish with parsley and serve with the pan juices spooned over top.

recipes.title: Orecchiette with Broccoli Rabe, Sausage, and Garlic
instructions: Cook orecchiette in salted boiling water. Add chopped broccoli rabe in the last 3 minutes to cook until very tender. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, then drain together.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large skillet. Crumble in sausage and cook until browned, breaking into small pieces, about 6 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same skillet, heat remaining olive oil. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook gently until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes.
Add drained pasta and broccoli rabe, the cooked sausage, and 0.5 cup pasta water.
Toss everything together over medium heat. Add lemon juice and more pasta water as needed.
Serve immediately in warm bowls.

recipes.title: Spanish Braised Chickpeas with Spinach and Smoked Paprika
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat.
Sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes. Add garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin, cook 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and crushed tomatoes. Season with salt and pepper.
Simmer 15 minutes until sauce thickens and chickpeas are very tender.
Add spinach in large handfuls, stirring until wilted.
Finish with sherry vinegar and a final drizzle of olive oil.
Serve warm with soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Moroccan Vegetable Couscous with Seven Vegetables
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook until softened.
Add ras el hanout, turmeric, and cinnamon stick, stirring for 1 minute.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil. Add sweet potato, turnip, and tomatoes.
Simmer 15 minutes, then add zucchini, cabbage, and chickpeas.
Continue simmering 20 minutes until all vegetables are very tender.
Meanwhile, prepare couscous by pouring 2 cups boiling salted water over couscous, covering, and letting sit 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
Mound couscous on a large platter, ladle the vegetable stew over and around.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with harissa on the side for added heat.

recipes.title: Slow-Braised Lamb Shanks with Red Wine and Rosemary
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C). Season lamb shanks generously with salt and pepper.
Heat olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear lamb shanks on all sides until deeply browned, about 8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Reduce heat to medium. Add onion, carrots, and celery. Cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Pour in red wine and scrape up any browned bits. Let reduce by half.
Add crushed tomatoes, broth, rosemary, and bay leaves. Return lamb shanks to the pot.
Cover and transfer to oven. Braise for 2-2.5 hours until lamb is completely fall-off-the-bone tender.
Remove shanks and discard rosemary sprigs and bay leaves. If sauce is thin, simmer on stovetop to reduce.
Serve lamb shanks over soft polenta or mashed potatoes with the braising sauce.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers with Rice, Herbs, and Tomato Sauce
instructions: Cut the tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. Blanch peppers in boiling water for 3 minutes to soften. Drain upside down.
Heat olive oil in a skillet. Cook onion until soft, add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess fat.
Stir in cooked rice, parsley, mint, cumin, allspice, salt, pepper, and 0.5 cup tomato sauce.
Stuff each bell pepper with the mixture and place upright in a baking dish.
Pour remaining tomato sauce around the peppers.
Cover with foil and bake at 375°F (190°C) for 35-40 minutes until peppers are very tender.
Uncover for the last 10 minutes. Serve with the sauce spooned over top.

recipes.title: Linguine alle Vongole (Pasta with Clams)
instructions: Cook linguine in salted boiling water until 1 minute short of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water, drain.
While pasta cooks, heat olive oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until garlic is golden, about 2 minutes.
Pour in white wine and bring to a boil. Add clams, cover, and cook 5-7 minutes until all clams open. Discard any that don't open.
Add the drained linguine to the skillet with the clams. Toss over medium heat for 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of pasta water to create a glossy sauce.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley. Toss once more and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Eggplant Parmesan (Melanzane alla Parmigiana)
instructions: Salt eggplant slices, let sit 20 minutes, then pat completely dry.
Brush both sides with olive oil and bake on sheet pans at 400°F (200°C) for 20 minutes until soft.
Make sauce: sauté garlic in remaining olive oil for 1 minute, add crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, pepper, and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce oven to 375°F (190°C).
Spread a thin layer of sauce in a 9x13 baking dish. Layer eggplant, sauce, mozzarella slices, parmesan, and basil. Repeat layers.
Finish with sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan on top.
Bake 30 minutes until bubbly and cheese is melted.
Rest 15 minutes before slicing. Garnish with fresh basil.

recipes.title: Fasolada (Greek White Bean Soup)

ingredients.displayName: Dried Great Northern Beans, soaked overnight

instructions: Drain soaked beans, place in a large pot, cover with fresh water, and boil for 10 minutes. Drain.
In the same pot, heat 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, tomato paste, and oregano. Cook 1 minute.
Add beans, crushed tomatoes, bay leaves, and 8 cups water.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer gently for 50-60 minutes until beans are very soft and creamy.
Discard bay leaves. Season with salt and pepper.
Serve in deep bowls with a generous drizzle of remaining olive oil and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Spanish Gazpacho (Chilled Tomato Soup)
instructions: Roughly chop tomatoes, cucumber, and bell pepper.
Soak the bread in water for 1 minute, then squeeze dry.
Place all vegetables, soaked bread, garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar, salt, and pepper in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth, at least 1 minute.
Strain through a fine sieve for ultra-smooth texture if desired.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours (overnight is best).
Serve cold in chilled bowls with a drizzle of olive oil and diced cucumber garnish.

recipes.title: Italian Minestrone with Soft Pasta
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add zucchini and green beans, cook 3 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes, vegetable broth, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil.
Add ditalini pasta and both beans. Reduce heat and simmer 15-20 minutes until pasta and vegetables are very soft.
Stir in baby spinach until wilted.
Discard bay leaf. Ladle into bowls and finish with a drizzle of good olive oil.
Serve with parmesan on the side for non-vegan option.

recipes.title: Turkish Red Lentil Soup (Mercimek Çorbası)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrot, potato, and garlic. Cook 3 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, 1 teaspoon cumin, and half the paprika. Cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce and simmer 20-25 minutes until lentils and vegetables are completely soft.
Blend the soup with an immersion blender until velvety smooth.
Stir in lemon juice and season with salt.
In a small pan, melt butter and stir in remaining cumin, paprika, and red pepper flakes until fragrant.
Ladle soup into bowls and drizzle with the spiced butter. Serve with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Moroccan Harira (Chickpea and Tomato Soup)
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot. Sauté onion and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, cinnamon, and cumin. Cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add ground lamb, breaking up with a spoon, and cook until browned.
Add crushed tomatoes, chickpeas, lentils, and chicken broth.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 35-40 minutes until lentils are completely soft.
Stir in cilantro, parsley, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and serve in deep bowls with soft bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Creamy Roasted Cauliflower Soup with Za'atar
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Toss cauliflower with 2 tablespoons olive oil, salt, and pepper. Roast 25 minutes until very soft and golden.
Heat remaining oil in a large pot. Sauté onion until soft, add garlic, cook 1 minute.
Add roasted cauliflower and vegetable broth. Bring to a simmer and cook 5 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth with an immersion blender.
Stir in yogurt and lemon juice. Season to taste.
Ladle into bowls, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with za'atar.

recipes.title: Avgolemono (Greek Lemon Chicken Soup)
instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large pot. Add chicken breast, reduce to a simmer, and poach for 15 minutes until cooked through.
Remove chicken and shred with two forks. Keep broth simmering.
Add rice to the broth and cook 15 minutes until very tender.
In a bowl, whisk eggs until frothy. While whisking constantly, slowly ladle 2 cups of the hot broth into the eggs to temper them.
Pour the egg-broth mixture back into the pot, stirring constantly. Do not boil.
Add lemon juice, lemon zest, and shredded chicken. Stir until soup is creamy and slightly thickened.
Season with salt and white pepper. Serve garnished with fresh dill.

recipes.title: Creamy Hummus
instructions: Process tahini and lemon juice in a food processor for 1 minute until thick and creamy.
Add garlic, cumin, and salt. Process 30 seconds.
Add chickpeas and process 1 minute.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil and ice water. Process a full 3-4 minutes until extremely smooth and fluffy.
Taste and adjust salt and lemon.
Transfer to a serving bowl, create a well in the center, drizzle with olive oil, and dust with paprika.
Serve with warm soft pita bread.

recipes.title: Baba Ganoush (Smoky Eggplant Dip)
instructions: Prick eggplants all over with a fork. Char directly over a gas flame or under a broiler, turning frequently, until skin is blackened and flesh is completely collapsed, about 15-20 minutes.
Let cool slightly, then peel off the charred skin and drain the flesh in a colander for 10 minutes.
Mash the eggplant flesh with a fork (for rustic texture) or pulse briefly in a food processor.
Stir in tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, smoked paprika, and salt.
Transfer to a serving plate, drizzle with olive oil, and garnish with parsley and pomegranate seeds if using.

recipes.title: Greek Tzatziki Sauce

ingredients.displayName: English Cucumber, grated and squeezed dry

instructions: Grate cucumber on the large holes of a box grater. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and let sit 5 minutes.
Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean towel to remove as much liquid as possible.
In a bowl, combine yogurt, squeezed cucumber, garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, dill, and mint if using.
Season with salt and white pepper. Mix well.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving for best flavor.
Drizzle with a little olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Soft Braised Fennel with Parmesan
instructions: Heat olive oil and butter in a large oven-safe skillet over medium heat.
Place fennel quarters cut-side down and sear until lightly golden, about 4 minutes.
Add garlic, white wine, and broth. Season with salt and pepper.
Cover and braise over low heat for 20-25 minutes until fennel is completely soft and translucent.
Remove lid, increase heat to reduce any remaining liquid to a glaze.
Drizzle with lemon juice and top with shaved parmesan. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Salade Niçoise (Tender Composed Salad)
instructions: Boil potatoes until very tender, about 12 minutes. Drain and halve.
Cook green beans in salted boiling water for 5 minutes until very tender (not crisp). Transfer to ice water briefly, then drain.
Soft-boil eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in ice water, then peel and halve.
Whisk together olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, and salt for the dressing.
Arrange potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, tuna, eggs, olives, and red onion on a platter.
Drizzle with the vinaigrette and scatter fresh basil over the top.
Serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Italian Marinated White Beans with Herbs

ingredients.displayName: Canned Cannellini Beans, drained and rinsed

instructions: Gently toss drained beans with olive oil, red wine vinegar, garlic, and sun-dried tomatoes.
Add red onion, parsley, and basil. Season with salt and pepper.
Let marinate at room temperature for at least 15 minutes (up to 2 hours) before serving.
Serve as a side dish or spoon over soft bread.

recipes.title: Muhammara (Roasted Red Pepper and Seed Dip)
instructions: Place sunflower seeds in a food processor and pulse until finely ground (but not a paste).
Add roasted red peppers, breadcrumbs, pomegranate molasses, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Process until smooth, scraping down the sides as needed.
With the processor running, drizzle in olive oil until well combined.
Transfer to a bowl, drizzle with a little more olive oil, and serve with warm soft pita.

recipes.title: Spanakopita Bites (Spinach and Feta Phyllo Rolls)

ingredients.displayName: Frozen Spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

instructions: Mix spinach, feta, ricotta, green onions, egg, dill, nutmeg, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Lay one sheet of phyllo on a work surface and brush lightly with melted butter.
Spoon a line of filling along the long edge and roll up into a cylinder. Cut into 2-inch pieces.
Repeat with remaining phyllo and filling.
Place pieces seam-side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush tops with butter.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 18-20 minutes until golden and the layers are soft-flaky (not hard).
Let cool 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Labneh Balls Marinated in Olive Oil and Herbs
instructions: Line a sieve with cheesecloth over a bowl. Place labneh in cheesecloth, gather edges, and refrigerate to drain further for at least 4 hours or overnight.
Roll the thickened labneh into small balls, about 1 tablespoon each. You should get about 20-24 balls.
Place labneh balls in a clean jar.
Add garlic slices, lemon peel, thyme, rosemary, za'atar, red pepper flakes, and salt.
Pour olive oil over to completely cover the balls.
Seal and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before serving.
Serve at room temperature with soft warm bread, spooning some of the flavored oil alongside.

recipes.title: Kao Tom (Thai Rice Porridge)
instructions: Rinse jasmine rice under cold water until water runs clear, then drain.
In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil over high heat.
Add rice, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice breaks down and the mixture becomes porridge-like.
While porridge simmers, slice chicken breast into thin bite-sized pieces.
Add garlic, ginger, and chicken to the pot. Cook for 8–10 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Season with fish sauce and white pepper. Stir well.
If using eggs, crack them into the porridge and gently stir to create egg ribbons.
Ladle into bowls and top with green onions, fresh cilantro, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Thai Coconut Rice Pudding Breakfast
instructions: Rinse rice until water runs clear. Combine rice, coconut milk, water, palm sugar, salt, and pandan leaf (if using) in a pot.
Bring to a boil over medium-high heat, stirring frequently to prevent sticking.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20–25 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until rice is very soft and creamy.
Remove pandan leaf. The pudding should be thick and porridge-like. Add a splash more coconut milk if too thick.
Serve warm in bowls, topped with diced fresh mango.

recipes.title: Kai Jeow (Thai Omelette)
instructions: Crack eggs into a bowl. Add fish sauce, lime juice, sliced green onion, and white pepper. Beat vigorously until slightly frothy.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or skillet over high heat until the oil shimmers and is very hot.
Pour the egg mixture into the hot oil. It should puff up immediately.
Let it cook for about 1–2 minutes until the bottom is golden and the edges are set.
Flip the omelette and cook for another 1 minute until golden on both sides but still tender inside.
Slide onto a plate. Serve over steamed jasmine rice with sriracha on the side.

recipes.title: Thai Shrimp Congee
instructions: Rinse rice and drain. In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil.
Add rice and reduce heat to medium-low. Simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is very soft and broken down.
In a small pan, sauté garlic and ginger in a teaspoon of oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the garlic-ginger mixture and celery to the congee. Stir well.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3–4 minutes until shrimp turn pink and are cooked through.
Season with fish sauce and white pepper.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with cilantro and extra julienned ginger.

recipes.title: Thai Sweet Black Rice Porridge with Coconut
instructions: Soak black sticky rice in water for at least 30 minutes (or overnight). Drain.
In a pot, combine soaked rice and 3 cups of water. Bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rice is very tender and porridge-like.
Stir in half of the coconut milk, palm sugar, and salt. Cook for another 5 minutes.
Serve warm in bowls, drizzled with remaining coconut milk and topped with sliced banana.

recipes.title: Kai Toon (Thai Steamed Eggs)
instructions: Whisk eggs gently in a bowl (avoid creating too many bubbles). Mix in chicken broth, fish sauce, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Strain the egg mixture through a fine mesh sieve into a heatproof bowl or ramekins to ensure a silky smooth texture.
Place the bowls into a steamer. Cover and steam over medium heat for 12–15 minutes until the eggs are just set but still jiggly.
Remove from steamer. Top with sliced green onion and cilantro. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Kluay Buat Chi (Thai Banana in Coconut Milk)
instructions: In a saucepan, heat coconut milk with palm sugar, salt, and pandan leaf (if using) over medium heat. Stir until sugar dissolves.
Bring to a gentle simmer. Add banana chunks.
Cook for 5–7 minutes until bananas are soft and tender but not mushy.
Remove pandan leaf. Serve warm in bowls with plenty of coconut milk broth.

recipes.title: Jok Moo (Thai Pork Congee)
instructions: Rinse rice and drain. In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil with ginger slices.
Add rice, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring frequently, until rice completely breaks down into a thick porridge.
Season ground pork with half the soy sauce and a pinch of white pepper. Form into small meatballs (about 1-inch each).
Drop pork meatballs into the simmering congee. Cook for 8 minutes until pork is cooked through.
Crack eggs into the congee, one at a time, letting each poach for about 3 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, remaining soy sauce, and white pepper.
Ladle into bowls with a poached egg in each. Garnish with green onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Thai Pineapple Curry Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add shrimp and cook for 2 minutes until pink. Push shrimp to the side of the wok.
Crack eggs into the wok and scramble until just set.
Add curry powder and stir-fry for 30 seconds until aromatic.
Add the cold cooked rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes.
Add pineapple, red bell pepper, and raisins (if using). Toss to combine.
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes.
Remove from heat. Garnish with green onions and cilantro. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pad See Ew (Wide Rice Noodles with Soy Sauce)

ingredients.displayName: Wide Rice Noodles (fresh or soaked dried)
Chinese Broccoli (Gai Lan), cut into pieces

instructions: If using dried wide rice noodles, soak in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable, then drain.
Mix dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar in a small bowl. Set aside.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Add garlic and stir-fry for 15 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until cooked through. Push to one side.
Crack eggs into the wok and scramble until just set.
Add noodles and pour the sauce mixture over them. Toss everything together, coating the noodles evenly.
Add Chinese broccoli and stir-fry for 2 minutes until the stems are tender and the noodles have slight char marks.
Season with white pepper. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Pad Krapow Gai (Thai Basil Chicken) over Rice
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Add garlic and Thai chilies, stir-fry for 30 seconds.
Add ground chicken, breaking it apart with a spatula. Cook for 4–5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add oyster sauce, fish sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and sugar. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Turn off heat and fold in Thai basil leaves, letting them wilt from the residual heat.
If desired, fry eggs sunny-side-up in a separate pan with a bit of oil.
Serve the basil chicken over steamed jasmine rice, topped with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Khao Pad (Thai Fried Rice)
instructions: Heat oil in a wok over high heat. Add garlic and stir-fry for 15 seconds.
Add diced chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until cooked through.
Push chicken to the side. Crack eggs into the wok and scramble until just set.
Add onion and tomato. Stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add cold rice, breaking up any clumps. Stir-fry vigorously for 3 minutes.
Season with fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and white pepper. Toss well.
Serve garnished with green onions, lime wedges, and cucumber slices.

recipes.title: Pad Thai (Nut-Free)

ingredients.displayName: Roasted Sunflower Seed Kernels (instead of peanuts)

instructions: Soak rice noodles in room temperature water for 30 minutes until pliable. Drain.
In a small bowl, mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and palm sugar until sugar dissolves. Set pad thai sauce aside.
Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok over high heat. Cook tofu cubes until lightly golden on all sides (about 3 minutes). Remove and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil. Stir-fry chicken for 3 minutes, then add shrimp and cook until pink. Remove and set aside with tofu.
Add remaining oil. Stir-fry garlic and shallot for 30 seconds. Push to the side.
Crack eggs into the wok and scramble until just set.
Add the drained noodles and pad thai sauce. Toss and cook for 2–3 minutes, letting noodles absorb the sauce and become tender.
Return chicken, shrimp, and tofu to the wok. Add bean sprouts and garlic chives. Toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately with lime wedges and a sprinkle of sunflower seed kernels if desired.

recipes.title: Larb Gai (Thai Chicken Salad)
instructions: Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add ground chicken and break it apart. Cook for 5–6 minutes until cooked through.
Remove from heat and transfer chicken to a mixing bowl. Let cool for 2 minutes.
Add lime juice, fish sauce, chili flakes, and toasted rice powder. Toss well.
Add shallots, green onions, cilantro, and mint. Toss to combine.
Serve scooped into butter lettuce cups for a soft, refreshing wrap.

recipes.title: Pad Kee Mao (Drunken Noodles)
instructions: Soak dried wide rice noodles in warm water for 20 minutes until pliable. Drain. If using fresh noodles, separate them gently.
Mix oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar in a small bowl.
Heat oil in a wok over very high heat until smoking. Add garlic and chilies, stir-fry for 15 seconds.
Add chicken and stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until cooked.
Add bell pepper and baby corn, stir-fry for 1 minute.
Add noodles and pour the sauce over them. Toss vigorously for 2–3 minutes until noodles are evenly coated and tender.
Turn off heat, fold in Thai basil leaves until just wilted. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Fried Rice (Khao Pad Krapow)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok over high heat. Fry eggs sunny-side-up until edges are set but yolk is runny. Set aside.
